name: What is the process for a garage interior finishing project?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for a garage interior finishing project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with an initial consultation to understand your vision and requirements. Next, we provide a detailed proposal and design plan. Upon approval, we handle necessary permits. Construction then proceeds, involving insulation, drywall, flooring, and any custom installations. Throughout the project, we maintain clear communication and conclude with a final walkthrough to ensure your satisfaction.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves consultation, proposal, permitting, construction (insulation, drywall, flooring), and a final walkthrough.
